API-ARCH-001.rationale: Provider inputs bind the test to an explicit endpoint fixture.

API-ARCH-002.rationale: The API flow provider reads a repository-contained flow file.

API-ARCH-003.rationale: The suite template declares three independent provider nodes.

API-CONF-001.rationale: Typed scalar variables support later interpolation.

API-CONF-002.rationale: The versioned flow has an ordered setup group.

API-CONF-003.rationale: The versioned flow has an always-visited cleanup group.

API-CONF-004.rationale: Each request declares its request data.

API-CONF-006.rationale: The provider rejects other flow versions.

API-HTTP-001.rationale: The live test uses a real local HTTP server.

API-HTTP-002.rationale: The live test uses a real WebSocket server.

API-HTTP-003.rationale: The capability enforces the smaller provider or node timeout.

API-HTTP-004.rationale: The capability has explicit operator allowlists and byte limits.

API-ASSERT-003.rationale: Missing response text creates a failure.

API-ASSERT-004.rationale: Own-property JSON selectors compare exact values.

API-ASSERT-005.rationale: WebSocket count and content assertions are strict.

API-FLOW-001.rationale: Setup response extraction supplies an authorization value.

API-FLOW-002.rationale: Missing variable use skips only that main step.

API-FLOW-003.rationale: Cleanup is a separate final group.

API-OAS-001.rationale: Configuration requires explicit operations or tags.

API-OAS-002.rationale: An empty selection is an execution error.

API-OAS-003.rationale: Path, query, header, and body checks run before invoke.

API-OAS-004.rationale: Runtime response checks cover the declared response contract.

API-EVID-001.rationale: Both providers stage relative JSON evidence files.

API-EVID-002.rationale: Provider details include status and timing but omit response bodies.

API-DEFECT-001.rationale: Every failed assertion fails a blocking node.

API-DEFECT-002.rationale: There is no informational success default.

API-CUT-001.rationale: Only provider plan execution remains authoritative.
